text:
nina: Quick heads-up from a customer POC: our sampleapps are producing different embedding lengths and rerank score types when using the new batch helper. Node sampleapp returns 512-d vectors; Python returns 384-d for the same inputs.

omar: yikes. Any recent changes to the batch helper?

nina: yes, there was a refactor last week. Node exposes `pad_to` in the helper options, Python added `pad_to_len` (different name), and there's also a boolean flag `trim_zero_tail` defaulting to true in Python. That means Python trims trailing zeros from padded embeddings before sending.

kai: that would explain differing lengths. If server expects padded vectors, downstream nearest-neighbor indexing will break. Do we have sample payloads?

nina: pasted small snippets below. Node request:```json
{"model":"embed-proto-v2","inputs":[[0.12,0.22]],"pad_to":512}
```Python request:```json
{"model":"embed-proto-v2","vectors":[[0.12,0.22]],"pad_to_len":512,"trim_zero_tail":true}
```Node response (server):```json
{"embedding":[0.01,0.02, /* ... */, 0.0] /* length 512 */}
```Python response (client-observed):```json
{"embedding":[0.01,0.02, /* ... */] /* length 384 due to trim */}
```

sam: besides pad param name, did we change retry headers? Last month we made the client retryer use `X-Retry-Request` header for internal tracing; server handles `Idempotency-Key` for dedupe. If Python isn't mapping X-Retry-Request -> Idempotency-Key, retries can create double entries.

omic: (typo: omar) We also saw rerank results come back with `scores` as strings from an old Python JSON serializer: "scores": ["0.87","0.45"] instead of floats. That caused our ranking comparator to crash (type error).

kai: we need a short plan: 1) unify option names (pad_to) across SDKs, 2) default trim_zero_tail=false in Python until parity confirmed, 3) map retry header to Idempotency-Key on Python retryer, 4) client-side schema validation that embeddings in a batch share identical length and that scores are floats.

omar: agreed. I'll open a patch to the python helper to rename `pad_to_len` -> `pad_to` and flip the default for `trim_zero_tail`. Also will add mapping in retryer: if internal retry id exists, set `Idempotency-Key` header. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/1798 (draft).

sdk-qa: i'll add integration tests: run node+python sampleapps with randomized seq lengths, assert all returned embeddings have same dim, assert rerank `scores` are numeric. Also add a stress test for 409/500 retries to ensure idempotency header is passed.

nina: repro steps for QA: 1) run node sampleapp (`yarn dev`) 2) run python sampleapp (venv + `python app.py`) 3) POST /batch-embed on both with mixed-length inputs 4) compare vector lengths and insert behavior into a tmp sqlite index.

sam: we should consider server-side guards: if the server receives `pad_to` in request, it should return `embedding.dim` in the response metadata and reject variable-length vectors in a single batch. That will make misbehaving clients fail fast.

omar: good idea. I'll open a tiny API tweak: add `response.meta.embedding_dim` and 400 if inconsistent lengths detected. Backend PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/5064 (wip).

sdk-qa: while testing, found one more oddity: when Python hits a 409 and retries without idempotency header, it sometimes gets a shorter vector on the retry (server had returned a partial result). That causes duplicate rows after dedupe logic fails. We'll add a client enforcement: on retry, do not alter payload shape; if altered, raise error and log.

ci-bot: ci: pipeline triggered for sdk-python PR #1798 (tests: unit, lint, int)

kai: ETA on python hotfix?

omar: can land the rename + default change in ~90m, run integration tests in staging. If green, can roll a patch release.

sdk-qa: running staged integration now against build 1012. Will post results in 45m.

nina: long-term, let's document the batch helper options in the onboarding guide with explicit examples showing `pad_to` and the server `embedding.dim`. Many users assumed variable-length was fine. Also add an FAQ about idempotency headers and retry behavior.

sam: I'll prepare a small DB cleanup script to dedupe rows created by earlier mismatched retries — will coordinate with infra for a low-impact run.

sdk-qa: staging results: embedding dims now match across Node/Python after applying python patch; rerank score types normalized by adding float-parse in client. No duplicate inserts observed in a 2000-request run.

omar: great. Will proceed to release patch and update release notes.

kai: thanks all. Follow-up: add an SDK lint rule to flag mismatched option names between repos on PR (catch parity issues earlier).
